headline: Linn of Mercy Erupts as Savage Attrition Sweeps Central Fronts
war_summary: Linn of Mercy has flared into the war's sharpest flashpoint over the past three hours, logging ten territorial transactions around Lathair and Rotdust that have left one strategic stronghold in ruins as casualties climb sharply. In Weathered Expanse, bitter fighting continues unabated, registering recent base transitions at Crow's Nest and Frostmarch alongside nearly four thousand combined losses over two hours. Stonecradle and Callahan's Passage remain brutal engines of attrition; while Stonecradle's frantic base turnover paused during the latest watch, both sectors suffered staggering losses exceeding four thousand and thirty-six hundred casualties in two hours, respectively. On the Stlican Shelf, heavy combat surged again with over two thousand fallen in two hours across its partitioned front. Out west, Oarbreaker marked localized base upheaval at Grisly Refuge before settling, while sectors such as Dead Lands, Mooring County, and the coastal perimeters remain largely static despite minor casualty upticks. The war's decisive momentum stays firmly locked across the contested interior corridors.
